Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE1 only, faithfully redraw its TWO COMPLETE ORIGINAL VR animation drawings on one 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Keep the upper whole drawing centered in the top half and the lower whole drawing centered in the bottom half, in EXACTLY their source locations and sizes. Leave the wide source margins: every pixel stays at least 56px inside its half. These are deliberately FLAT ORANGE AND MAROON POLYGON SHAPES from Sam & Max Hit the Road's virtual-reality game. Their entire unusual deformed shape, disconnected facets and transparent gaps are intentional and must remain exact. Paint each WHOLE source together; do not reconstruct individual parts. Smooth only the raster stair steps into clean antialiased angular edges. Retain the SAME FLAT COLOR in each source facet, no new highlights, no gradients, no outlines, no texture, no shadow or glow.

SOURCE MEANING: TWO complete consecutive sources, dragon flattening/unfolding with the game heart hovering above. Upper: left pointed head floats detached above the left orange lower body, black small eyes and maroon upper head strips. The maroon diagonal central/right band stretches up to the right forked pointed shape with its two slim dark maroon slits. Two orange bent legs/feet below. Small yellow/pink flattened sword remnant at right points diagonally down-right. Lower: flattened LEFT pointed head and maroon layered crest lowered; several separated orange/maroon crest triangles float ABOVE that left head, and three small slanted maroon/orange strips float above the RIGHT raised band. The red heart floats near the center above the body. Preserve both different whole silhouettes, exact disconnected crest pieces, body gaps, legs/feet and slim yellow/pink sword remnant pointing down at far right. Do not turn the right unfolding band into a new conventional head or rebuild the left head onto a normal neck.

IMAGE2 is the approved normal Sam master, identity/color support only; these sources contain NO SAM, so it must not introduce Sam, rounded anatomy or his clothes. IMAGE3 is actual game CONTEXT only, not a painting target. Do not paint the scene or the separate sword in the stone. The small flat RED GAME HEART is a virtual puzzle token that becomes a key, not anatomical tissue. Preserve its exact angular red and dark-red facets and its position within EACH WHOLE source. Everything else is the exact original orange/gold/maroon faceted virtual dragon in this intentional flattening/disassembly animation. Do not complete, remodel, tidy, correct into a whole normal dragon, rearrange or omit any source shape. Keep exact tiny yellow and pink sword remnants if visible. No new pieces, extra particles, new details, normal body reconstruction, text, label, border, watermark, gray backdrop or scenery. Real transparent alpha in ALL source empty areas and all gaps; flat painted facets fully opaque. One 1536x1024 RGBA output. The atlas is enlarged only to make source shapes readable; final import places each whole painting at fixed 4x with no part reconstruction.
